title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::

items.text: Korea and Japan hosted the 2002 FIFA World Cup.
Soccer became more popular in our country after we hosted
It has inspired many children to become soccer players in their future.
The person I respect the most is Guss Hiddink.
He is the coach from Holland.
He came to Korea to train and coach our soccer team.
In spite of many difficulties, he never lost his confidence.
He always emphasized that we must start with the basics in order to win.
By working hard he was able to bring the Korean team to the World Cup semi finals.
At first, people didn't believe that he was successful.
But he continued to try his best.
Eventually he showed the whole country that he was able to succeed.
His confidence and positive attitude made our soccer team to be powerful.
